episodes.synopsis: WIXOSS is the hottest online game around, and it's played by Divas, girls who sing and dance as they play the game. Follow the story of Hirana as she aims for the top and follows the footsteps of her favorite Divas, Eternal Girl!
episodes.title: Head for the Top!

episodes.synopsis: It's time to pick a team name! Everyone's all excited to come up with their own ideas. But Hirana goofs and enters "No Name" when she registers...
episodes.title: There Are No Limits!

episodes.synopsis: Team No Limit faces off against Card Jockey, the best team in C class! With both sides aiming to move up in the ranks, who will be the victor?
episodes.title: I Don't Wanna Lose!

episodes.synopsis: No Limit is starting to attract attention, and are chosen to appear in a major tournament! Hirana wants to prepare a concert, but Akino is shy and embarrassed...
episodes.title: I'm Sorry

episodes.synopsis: No Limit drops out of the running for the tournament after their defeat. Akino feels responsible, but encouragement comes from an unlikely place.
episodes.title: I'm Not Scared Anymore

episodes.synopsis: Rei offers No Limit the song she wrote, the song she's always wanted to sing. But an unexpected encounter with her past throws a wrench into her plans.
episodes.title: Just Disappear

episodes.synopsis: Rei fights a battle against Madoka to put her past to rest, but Sanga has an unexpected secret that throws everything in a different light.
episodes.title: She's My Teammate!

episodes.synopsis: No Limit goes on a vacation to a fancy hotel, but runs into unexpected problems when their clothes, and their underwear, are stolen...
episodes.title: Let's Kyuru Kyurun!

episodes.synopsis: Hirana's search for the ultimate taiyaki leads her to make an unexpected friend, one that will change her life forever...
episodes.title: It's Fate!

episodes.synopsis: The girl Hirana met turns out to be a member of Deus Ex Machina, the hottest team in the Diva leagues. But when she challenges No Limit to a battle, is the team ready?
episodes.title: Don't Run Away!

episodes.synopsis: After her traumatizing defeat against Deus Ex Machina, Hirana is ready to give up the game for good. But the league has a special tournament coming up that just might give her another shot, if her friends can convince her to take it...
episodes.title: This Is My Limit...

episodes.synopsis: No Limit is back for one final shot against Deus Ex Machina. Can Hirana really make it to the top?
episodes.title: NO LIMIT!
